title: VoiceMailGreeting2Rep - Data API
description: Represents information about the voicemail message and its associated service rep. This object is available in API version 67.0 and later.

IsDefault.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsDefault.description: Whether this is the rep's default voicemail message (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

Name.description: The name of the voicemail message.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: User ID of the voicemail message owner. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

OwnerType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
OwnerType.description: The ownership type of the voicemail message. Possible values are: Owned Shared

RepId.description: ID of the rep associated with the voicemail message. This is a relationship field.

Sequence.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Sequence.description: The order in which the voicemail message is applied for the rep.

VoiceMailGreeting2Id.description: ID of the related VoiceMailGreeting2 record. This is a relationship field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **VoiceMailGreeting2RepShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
